criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Card Fraud and Security
categories.definition: Reports of unauthorized transactions, stolen cards, or compromised account security requiring immediate action.

categories.name: Card Status and Delivery
categories.definition: Inquiries regarding the ordering, delivery tracking, expiration, or physical status of a card.

categories.name: Card Functionality and Settings
categories.definition: Issues or questions about using the card, including declined payments, PIN management, and activation.

categories.name: Virtual Card
categories.definition: Questions specifically regarding the features, availability, or usage of virtual disposable cards.

categories.name: Top Up Issues
categories.definition: Problems experienced when attempting to add funds to the account, such as failed or pending top-ups.

categories.name: Top Up Fees and Limits
categories.definition: Questions concerning fees, limits, or policies related to adding money to the account.

categories.name: Incoming Transfer Issues
categories.definition: Reports of missing or delayed funds transferred from external bank accounts into the user's account.

categories.name: Outgoing Transfer Issues
categories.definition: Problems with sending money to others, including failed, declined, or delayed outgoing transfers.

categories.name: Transfer Fees and Policies
categories.definition: Inquiries about fees, processing times, or policies applicable to money transfers.

categories.name: Cash Withdrawal Issues
categories.definition: Problems encountered at ATMs, including failed withdrawals, captured cards, or incorrect dispensed amounts.

categories.name: Cash Deposit Issues
categories.definition: Reports of missing or delayed funds resulting from cash or cheque deposits.

categories.name: Transaction Disputes and Refunds
categories.definition: Requests to cancel transactions, dispute merchant charges, or resolve issues with missing refunds.

categories.name: Duplicate or Incorrect Transaction
categories.definition: Reports of duplicate charges, incorrect transaction amounts, or unrecognized transaction names.

categories.name: Transaction Status
categories.definition: Questions regarding the meaning or duration of pending transaction states.

categories.name: Exchange Rates and Currency
categories.definition: Questions about applicable exchange rates, currency conversion processes, or supported currencies.

categories.name: Fees Inquiry
categories.definition: General questions about service fees, card usage fees, or unexplained charges not specific to transfers or top-ups.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Issues or questions regarding the process, requirements, or necessity of verifying personal identity.

categories.name: Account Management
categories.definition: Requests to update personal details, close accounts, or manage account access and settings.

categories.name: App and Technical Support
categories.definition: Technical difficulties using the mobile app or website, including login issues and feature bugs.

categories.name: General Information
categories.definition: General questions about company operations, supported regions, age requirements, or product availability.
